one_line: Royal architect of the Travancore court, shaping Padmanabhapuram and Krishnapuram palaces in 18th‑century Kerala.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly weathered from site work
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed mustache, faint smile lines at the eyes, default expression a calm, focused gaze that suggests measured precision and quiet pride.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and combed back into a low knot at the nape, with a simple narrow white cotton headband tied around the forehead, ends tucked neatly at the back.
appearance.costume: He wears an 18th‑century Kerala-style off-white cotton mundu (wrap lower garment) reaching the ankles with a narrow maroon and gold kasavu border, pleated slightly at the front for ease of movement, paired with a long-sleeved, collarless light-cream cotton angarakha-style upper cloth that overlaps and ties subtly on the right side; over his left shoulder is a soft handwoven reddish-brown shawl (upper cloth) with thin mustard stripes, draped diagonally and tucked at the waist, and on his feet simple brown leather sandals; around his neck a single small tulsi bead mala and a thin gold chain, and on his right wrist a plain copper bangle, while his forehead bears a small, discreet sandalwood tilak blended into his skin tone.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin coir cord held in his left hand, with a slim wooden stylus tucked into the cord, and under his right arm a small rectangular wooden board bearing a neatly sketched elevation of a sloping Kerala roof and courtyard verandas.

ref_desc: A mid-30s medium-brown man with an oval face, neat mustache, black hair in a back knot with white headband, wearing an off-white mundu with maroon-gold border, cream angarakha, reddish-brown striped shawl and sandals, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus and a wooden drawing board, in off-white, maroon, reddish-brown and mustard tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a mid-30s Travancore court architect from 18th-century Kerala: a lean, medium-brown man with an oval face, sharp nose, calm focused eyes and a neat mustache, his thick black hair oiled back into a low knot wrapped with a narrow white headband. He wears an off-white cotton mundu reaching his ankles with a narrow maroon and gold kasavu border, slightly pleated in front, and a long-sleeved, collarless light-cream angarakha-style upper garment overlapping and tying to the right. A soft reddish-brown shawl with thin mustard stripes is draped over his left shoulder and tucked at the waist, and he stands in simple brown leather sandals. Add subtle jewelry: a thin gold chain and a small tulsi bead mala at his neck, a plain copper bangle on his right wrist, and a discreet sandalwood tilak on his forehead. In his left hand he firmly holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin coir cord with a slim wooden stylus tucked into it, while under his right arm he carries a small rectangular wooden board showing a neat line sketch of a sloping Kerala tiled roof, deep veranda and courtyard. Use a palette dominated by off-white, maroon, reddish-brown, mustard yellow and warm brown, and pose him in a dignified, slightly three-quarter stance with multiple views to show his face, hair knot, costume details, shawl drape and his architectural tools clearly.
